input.text: You are standing at eight of twenty in the room where six people have died. The thing that killed all six of them is in here with you, and not one of them looked at it before they swung. Try that. Look at the troll — read what comes back, all of it. Then drink, or swing, or go back south. All three are real answers. One of them is wrong.

items.text: Answered Chris's prayer directly — he's a live player at 8/20 standing in the troll room, having speedrun past every description in the world; I pointed him at the one mechanic that makes it dangerous rather than handing him anything. Otherwise let it be.
